If your speed exceeds the required distance to stop short of a collision, it readies your brakes to apply maximum stopping force when you use them. description: Experience the perfect combination of electrified performance, everyday versatility, and Toyota's legendary reliability with the 2021 Toyota RAV4 Prime SE. Designed for drivers who want the flexibility of electric driving without sacrificing the convenience of a gasoline engine, this plug in hybrid SUV delivers exhilarating acceleration, impressive efficiency, and the practicality that makes the RAV4 one of the most popular SUVs on the road. Whether you're commuting, traveling, or exploring new destinations, the RAV4 Prime SE is ready for every mile.  Toyota's advanced Plug In Hybrid System provides responsive power with the ability to complete many daily drives using electric power alone before seamlessly transitioning to hybrid operation for extended journeys. The result is outstanding fuel efficiency, smooth acceleration, and the confidence to travel farther without worrying about charging availability. A refined suspension and responsive handling create a comfortable, composed ride that makes every trip enjoyable.  Inside, the RAV4 Prime SE offers a spacious, thoughtfully designed cabin built around comfort and convenience. Premium cloth seating, heated front seats, dual zone automatic climate control, and a power adjustable driver's seat create a welcoming environment for every drive. The roomy interior provides comfortable seating for passengers, while the versatile cargo area and 60/40 split folding rear seats make it easy to transport groceries, luggage, sporting equipment, or gear for your next adventure.  Technology is seamlessly integrated throughout the cabin to keep you connected. Toyota's Audio Plus multimedia system features Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and Amazon Alexa compatibility, giving you convenient access to navigation, music, messaging, and your favorite apps. A user friendly touchscreen display, multiple USB charging ports, and a customizable digital driver information display help keep you informed and connected wherever the road leads.  Toyota Safety Sense 2.0 comes standard, providing a comprehensive suite of advanced driver assistance technologies designed to help enhance confidence behind the wheel. Features such as the Pre Collision System with Pedestrian Detection, Lane Departure Alert with Steering Assist, Lane Tracing Assist, Full Speed Dynamic Radar Cruise Control, and Automatic High Beams work together to support driver awareness. A Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert and a rearview camera provide additional confidence when changing lanes or maneuvering in tight spaces.  The exterior of the RAV4 Prime SE showcases bold, athletic styling with sculpted body lines, distinctive LED lighting, stylish alloy wheels, and a confident stance that reflects its sporty performance. Priced at $38,950 against an original MSRP of $69,345, this Glacier White metallic Q7 represents one of the most compelling luxury SUV values currently available in the Dallas-Fort Worth market. With just 24,260 miles on the odometer and remaining factory warranty coverage, this is a nearly-new Audi at a significantly reduced cost of entry.About This 2023 Audi Q7 45 TFSI Premium Plus This particular Q7 is a one-owner, lease return  which means it spent its first miles under Audi's strict lease standards and returned to market in exceptional condition. At just over 24,000 miles, it barely qualifies as lightly used. The striking white exterior is paired with the Black Optic Package, giving it an assertive, blacked-out aesthetic with 20-inch 10-Spoke-Star Design wheels wrapped in all-season run-flat tires. The factory warranty runs through 50,000 miles, and this vehicle has also been pre-certified for an extended warranty up to 100,000 miles, offering real peace of mind well into your ownership.The options on this vehicle read like a build sheet you'd expect on a fully loaded flagship  the Executive Package, Premium Plus Package, Black Optic Package, Towing Package, Bang & Olufsen premium sound system, ventilated front seats, and rear window shades are among the highlights. These options alone accounted for over $10,000 of the original build cost, and you're inheriting all of it at a fraction of the price.2023 Audi Q7 Performance and Engine The Q7 45 TFSI is powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine paired with Audi's smooth 8-speed Tiptronic automatic transmission and Quattro all-wheel drive. While some buyers gravitate toward the V6 variants, the 2.0T in the Q7 delivers a surprisingly confident driving experience for daily use  producing 248 horsepower and 273 lb-ft of torque with strong low-end pull that suits both highway cruising and urban driving in North Texas traffic.The Tiptronic transmission gives you the option of paddle-shift control when you want a more engaged feel, and Quattro AWD distributes power intelligently across all four wheels for confident handling in everything from dry Texas highways to unexpected rain. Fuel economy is a genuine strength of this powertrain  expect around 19 MPG city and 26 MPG highway, solid numbers for a three-row luxury SUV of this size. The Towing Package extends its utility further, allowing this Q7 to handle light trailer duty as well.Audi Q7 Features and Interior The Premium Plus trim is Audi's mid-to-upper tier on the Q7 ladder, and it comes loaded with features that transform daily commutes and weekend road trips alike. Inside, you'll find a refined cabin finished with genuine leather seating for up to seven passengers, a panoramic sunroof, and Audi's Virtual Cockpit digital instrumentation. The centerpiece of the infotainment setup is the MMI Navigation Plus system with a large touchscreen, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, and Audi's intuitive menu structure.The Bang & Olufsen 3D Advanced Sound System is a genuine highlight  a 19-speaker, 755-watt setup that audiophiles will appreciate on long drives. Ventilated front seats add a practical touch for Texas summers, and the rear window shades are a thoughtful comfort feature for passengers in the second row. The Executive Package adds further convenience and luxury touches, while the upgraded 20-inch wheels give the exterior a more commanding road presence without sacrificing ride quality significantly.Audi Q7 Reliability and OwnershipWhat Owners and Experts Say The 2023 Audi Q7 carries a strong reputation among three-row luxury SUVs. J.D. Power and Consumer Reports have both recognized this generation of Q7 for improved reliability compared to earlier iterations of the model. description: ALL-ELECTRIC, INNOVATIVE, NO-ACCIDENT, ONE-OWNER, NONSMOKER, READY FOR THE ROAD! The 2023 Tesla Model Y Long Range has become one of the world's most sought-after electric SUVs by combining impressive driving range, exhilarating performance, outstanding practicality, and cutting-edge technology into one remarkably versatile package. Whether you're commuting across town, taking a family road trip, or simply enjoying the effortless nature of electric driving, this Model Y delivers an ownership experience unlike traditional gasoline-powered SUVs. Equipped with Tesla's dual-motor ALL-WHEEL DRIVE system, this Model Y continuously distributes power between the front and rear wheels to maximize traction, stability, and efficiency. The result is outstanding year-round confidence in changing weather while providing the instant acceleration and composed handling that have become Tesla hallmarks. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The Model Y has earned its reputation by making electric vehicle ownership remarkably easy. Buyers appreciate its exceptional driving range, expansive cargo capacity, low operating costs, and constant software improvements delivered through over-the-air updates. Rather than simply replacing a gasoline SUV, the Model Y rethinks how an everyday family vehicle should perform, feel, and evolve throughout ownership. Its large rear hatch, flat cargo floor, generous passenger accommodations, and impressive efficiency make it equally comfortable serving as a commuter, road-trip companion, or family hauler. Combined with Tesla's extensive Supercharger network, the Model Y has helped remove many of the traditional concerns associated with electric vehicle ownership. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition The Model Y has received widespread praise from automotive journalists for its exceptional efficiency, brisk acceleration, practical interior packaging, intuitive ownership experience, and class-leading electric driving range. Reviewers have consistently highlighted its combination of performance, technology, and everyday usability as one of the strongest values in the premium electric SUV segment. Named an IIHS TOP SAFETY PICK+ when properly equipped. Earned a 5-Star Overall Safety Rating from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration. Frequently recognized among the world's best-selling electric vehicles. Warranty The odometer is hovering around the 36,907-mile mark, and it is STILL COVERED by the factory. Basic Vehicle Limited Warranty -- Comprehensive factory coverage remains in effect through November 11, 2027 or 50,000 miles, whichever occurs first. High-Voltage Battery & Drive Unit Warranty -- Protects the battery pack and electric drive system through November 11, 2031 or 120,000 miles, whichever occurs first. Extended service plans may also be available to provide additional peace of mind after the factory warranty expires. Standard Features The Long Range trim strikes an outstanding balance between performance, efficiency, and everyday usability. Compared with lower configurations, it offers greater driving range, dual-motor ALL-WHEEL DRIVE capability, quicker acceleration, and the confidence to tackle virtually any season. The minimalist cabin, expansive glass roof, premium interior materials, and abundant cargo space create an environment that feels both modern and exceptionally practical. Installed Options This Model Y benefits from several desirable factory features that enhance both appearance and everyday convenience. 20'' Induction Wheels -- Larger premium alloy wheels give the Model Y a more aggressive stance while complementing its athletic design. Premium Connectivity Capability -- Enables enhanced connected services including satellite-view mapping, music streaming, and additional online functionality (subscription may be required). Traffic-Aware Cruise Control (TACC) -- Automatically adjusts cruising speed to maintain a preset following distance, helping reduce driver fatigue during longer journeys. Additional factory equipment may be present but could not be independently verified. Accordingly, only confirmed factory-installed equipment has been listed. Mechanical Features Instant torque from Tesla's dual electric motors delivers smooth, effortless acceleration with virtually silent operation. Regenerative braking helps recover energy while slowing the vehicle, improving efficiency and allowing many everyday driving situations to be completed with minimal brake pedal use. The low-mounted battery pack contributes to excellent balance, confident cornering, and a reassuringly planted feel on the road. Electrified Vehicle The Long Range features a lithium-ion battery pack producing approximately 384 horsepower with an EPA-estimated driving range of 330 miles on a full charge when equipped as originally rated. Level 1 Charging (120V): Approximately 3-4 miles of range per hour. Level 2 Charging (240V): Up to approximately 30 miles of range per hour with compatible equipment. DC Fast Charging (Tesla Supercharger): Up to approximately 162 miles of range in about 15 minutes under ideal conditions. Exterior Features Clean, aerodynamic styling contributes not only to the Model Y's distinctive appearance but also to its impressive efficiency and quiet highway manners. Flush-mounted door handles, LED lighting, the expansive fixed glass roof, and premium 20'' Induction wheels create a modern appearance that remains instantly recognizable while maximizing aerodynamic performance. Interior Features Tesla's minimalist cabin places the focus on comfort, space, and simplicity. Supportive seating, generous rear passenger accommodations, and exceptional cargo versatility make this Model Y equally capable of daily commuting and extended family travel. The large rear hatch and folding rear seats further expand its already impressive utility. Infotainment & Technology A centrally mounted touchscreen controls nearly every vehicle function through Tesla's intuitive software interface. Wireless smartphone connectivity, Bluetooth, voice commands, over-the-air software updates, integrated navigation, and seamless Supercharger route planning create an ownership experience that continues to improve throughout the life of the vehicle. Safety Features Tesla equips the Model Y with an impressive collection of advanced safety technologies, including Traffic-Aware Cruise Control, Automatic Emergency Braking, Lane Departure Avoidance, Blind Spot Camera assistance, electronic stability control, and a comprehensive suite of occupant protection systems. Together, these technologies help inspire confidence whether driving across town or across the country. ... and there's SO MUCH more! This ONE-OWNER, NO-ACCIDENT Model Y Long Range offers an outstanding opportunity to enjoy one of today's most desirable electric SUVs with low mileage, remaining factory warranty coverage, and the everyday practicality that has made the Model Y a global success. It is equally rewarding whether you're new to electric driving or ready to upgrade your current EV. The only thing missing is your next destination.
